args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.2.9
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 (error rate ~18%). Actions taken: attempted rollback to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy release), but it was rejected because v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417. Rolled back to v2.2.9, the next most recent healthy release, in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Post-rollback health check verified healthy with error rate ~0.2%. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 regression, review v2.3.0 quarantine/CVE-2026-4417 remediation, and plan a fixed forward release.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy.
2. **Rollback attempt to v2.3.0**: Rejected — v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417, so it could not be deployed.
3. **Rollback to v2.2.9**: Succeeded in all production regions. Post-rollback health check confirms the service is healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.
4. **Incident opened**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** (on-call engineer paged) describing the v2.3.1 failures, the blocked v2.3.0 rollback due to the CVE quarantine, the successful rollback to v2.2.9, and follow-up items (investigate the v2.3.1 regression and remediate the v2.3.0 CVE so the service can be fixed forward).
